# Tech Base Axis

> Tech Base Axis is a web development and digital solutions company based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India, founded by Bikram Ghosh. It builds custom web applications, e-commerce platforms, automation and AI systems, and cloud-based software for clients in India and worldwide.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.tbaonline.online/): Company overview, services, client reviews and FAQ
- [Projects](https://www.tbaonline.online/projects): Portfolio of delivered software, web apps and digital solutions
- [Packages](https://www.tbaonline.online/packages): Web development packages, add-ons and pricing, with online booking
- [Contact](https://www.tbaonline.online/contact): Book an appointment, request a quote or send an enquiry
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.tbaonline.online/privacy)
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.tbaonline.online/terms)

## Key facts
- Location: Kolkata, West Bengal, India (serves clients globally, remote)
- Founder: Bikram Ghosh, full stack web developer and software architect
- Services: custom web development, e-commerce, automation, cloud and AI-powered software
- Stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Firebase, Supabase
